mrrlin-mcp - Mrrlin Phase 1 MCP server CLI

Usage:
  mrrlin-mcp serve              Run the stdio MCP server. Honors
                                MRRLIN_API_BASE_URL (default
                                https://api.mrrlin.com) and MRRLIN_TOKEN.
                                Use MRRLIN_API_BASE_URL=https://api-staging.mrrlin.com
                                to target the known staging API, or http://127.0.0.1:8787
                                for local development.

  mrrlin-mcp install-browser    Idempotently install the dedicated, pinned
                                Chromium into ~/.mrrlin/browser/browsers (its own
                                copy, isolated from the operator's Chrome and
                                codex-chrome). Run by configure bridge; safe to
                                re-run. Exits non-zero on download failure.

  mrrlin-mcp browser-serve      Launch the vendored @playwright/mcp against the
                                dedicated persistent profile
                                (~/.mrrlin/browser/profile, headed). This is the
                                command configure bridge wires for the
                                [mcp_servers.mrrlin-browser] block.

  mrrlin-mcp browser-status     Read-only check: is the shared browser session
                                actually occupied right now? Prints
                                {"busy":bool,"holderPid":number|null} to stdout.
                                A building block for admission control (not yet
                                wired into the scheduler or Director turn-start
                                — this only answers the question).

  mrrlin-mcp external-agents-serve
                                Launch the bundled @mrrlin-dev/external-agents
                                MCP server (multi-LLM dispatch pool). This is the
                                command configure bridge wires for the
                                [mcp_servers.external-agents] block.

  mrrlin-mcp configure bridge   Idempotently register Mrrlin in
  [--force]                     ~/.codex/config.toml (or CODEX_HOME). Adds an
                                [mcp_servers.mrrlin] block. Development
                                checkouts register the local dist/bin.cjs;
                                published npm installs register
                                `mrrlin-mcp serve`.
                                Bakes API-target env vars into the block as an
                                inline env table so `serve` boots even when the
                                local 127.0.0.1:8787 is not running. Setup guide:
                                  MRRLIN_API_BASE_URL=https://api-staging.mrrlin.com                                     mrrlin-mcp configure bridge
                                is the canonical staging path.
                                An explicit URL is the only routing selector at bake
                                time. Production is the default and needs no routing env.
                                Re-running BARE (no env vars) over a block you
                                already pinned to staging/a remote target is safe:
                                it keeps your env verbatim (reported as
                                'env-preserved') instead of conflicting, so the
                                same setup command doubles as an update command.
                                To CHANGE or REMOVE the baked target, re-run with
                                --force (or the new env vars).
                                --force replaces an existing conflicting block.
